sponsors.cursor: Optional per Official Rules 8.1; not used. Development used Claude Code. No Cursor credits were provided for this event.
meterless_engines: H-MEM - vendored official reference (Apache-2.0), wired into the agent loop: past calls recalled into debate packets, outcomes supersede records after scoring (src/agent/memory.py)
sponsors.meterless_runtime: Runtime 1.4 OpenAI-compatible provider implemented in src/integrations/llm.py; Nightshift is the primary AI provider route when configured (LLM_PROVIDER=meterless or a Meterless base URL/token present). Integration basis: Meterless team guidance Oct 19, confirmed directly to this project Oct 23 (HackOS #Help Meterless). M1-M4 note: the Oct 20 Nightshift build exposes no callable endpoint, so live runs used NVIDIA direct; the Oct 25 build (stated to add a callable M1-M4 endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8088) is being re-probed before submission. Every model call is logged per run (provider, served model, latency) in artifacts.json.
sponsors.nvidia: Nemotron (nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b) powers the bull/bear/judge debate; model name logged per request in run artifacts. Live runs call NVIDIA direct API, confirmed by the Meterless team (Oct 19, and directly to this project Oct 23) as fine for the NVIDIA award; calls route through Nightshift automatically when a Runtime endpoint is present.
sponsors.zetaris: Data harness: 46 REST tables over Yahoo Finance (quotes/bars via SQL through the Zetaris REST API); options chains via Yahoo direct (no options tables in Zetaris).
